comment: One 23x23 stripboard, values printed on the parts. Two of the 10uF capacitors are marked BP (bipolar electrolytic). Two LED resistors (CLR1, CLR2) carry no value. Transistors and D1-D4 are given by the legend as types only (N-channel JFET, NPN silicon hFE 140-180, germanium).
uncertain: Diodes: the legend says D1-D4 germanium and D5 1N5817, but D1 sits on the 9v strip (row A) drawn like a supply protection diode while D5 is drawn like the germanium D2/D4; the legend numbering may be off (D1 1N5817, D2-D5 germanium)

Transistor designators: the outside label Q3 points at a part drawn with D/S/G pins and the Q1/Q2 column holds one D/S/G and one C/B/E part; the board shows 2 JFETs and 5 BJTs in all, matching the legend's counts
82K (column 11, rows D-G) and 51K (column 22): printed clearly, unusual values
